chunks: His Lord heard his prayer, and averted the women's wiles from him. He verily hears and knows everything.
ai.seo_question: How did God protect Prophet Joseph from the women's wiles?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the efficacy of sincere supplication (du'a) as a means of divine intervention, where God actively neutralizes external threats to the righteous. It highlights the interplay between human effort and divine will, affirming that God's omniscience ensures the precise timing and manner of protection against the schemes of the women.
